integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A five-second cinematic single take inside a rain-lashed glass observatory at midnight. A radio astronomer leans toward a brass receiver and says clearly (S1) <d>[English] If you can hear me, follow this signal.</d> The camera makes a slow push from medium shot to close-up; her speech completes naturally within the shot with precise lip synchronization.
overall_soundscape: Rain rattling across the observatory dome, a low electrical hum, three clean receiver tones, and her synchronized voice.
non_diegetic_music: One quiet bowed-glass chord rising beneath the transmission and fading at the end.
